Senses.Explanation: Eyebrows falling is recorded as a verbal consequence or exposed fault, not as ordinary hair loss. A room instruction asks why its addressee still does not see after the eyebrows have fallen; an old-case verse links their fall to the eyes moving; Baichi accepts the risk when compelled to speak yet says his nostrils remain held high; Baochi answers the inherited question directly.
